item.title: Ore no Taisetsu na Osananajimi to Nikuki Kuso Oyaji
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: PHASE#END
  • 発売日: 2019-06-14
  • スコア: 6.57/10 (22 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 俺の大切な幼馴染と憎きクソ親父
  • 英語名: Ore no Taisetsu na Osananajimi to Nikuki Kuso Oyaji

あらすじ

The protagonist, Takuma, lost his mother when he was young.

In her place, there was someone who stepped into the kitchen for him.

That someone was Fumi, his childhood friend and next-door neighbor.

She was the kind of girl who could be a little nosy at times but always had a nurturing, caring nature. For Takuma, she was a presence big enough to fill the void left by his mother’s death.

  • 発売日: 2011-10-05

  • 日本語名: 濡れた後家花～義弟の姦計～
  • 英語名: Nureta Gokebana Gitei no Kankei

あらすじ

On a drizzly autumn day, in a room of a grand old Japanese house standing in quiet dignity, the young head of a venerable family, Izumi Mitsuteru, left his wife two final wishes…

One was to protect this house and its fortune from his wicked younger brother. And the other… to bear an heir to succeed the Izumi family.
